BOSM ’25

Cross-platform sports festival app for 6,000+ participants.

MY FOCUSMobile development & production releases
WHENAug — Sep 2025
BUILT WITHReact Native · Expo · TypeScript
6,000+festival participants
iOS + Androidcross-platform mobile app
End-to-enddevelopment through store releases

Context

BOSM, the BITS Open Sports Meet, brings thousands of participants to Pilani. The event app needed to put live schedules, scores, verification, and food ordering into one accessible place throughout the festival.

Implementation

I developed a cross-platform React Native and Expo application used by 6,000+ participants. The work covered the everyday flows that make an event easier to navigate:

  • Live match scheduling, so participants could keep track of where to be.
  • Automated leaderboard updates, bringing competition results into the app.
  • Participant verification and digital food ordering, connecting event operations with the participant experience.

RELEASE PIPELINE

React Native + TypeScript→Expo EAS→App Store + Google Play
One cross-platform application, with production releases maintained throughout the event.

Production releases

I owned production releases through Expo EAS, Google Play, and the Apple App Store, maintaining stable releases throughout the festival. Delivering the app meant seeing the work through the build and store-distribution process, then supporting it while people were using it.

Outcome

A single mobile app served the needs of 6,000+ participants during a national sports festival, bringing event information and operational workflows together.
